title: Recurrence, Orbit, Spiral & Door — Dynamical Systems and Physics Atlas
purpose: Give the Dog-return/circle/orbit/spiral/Axis material a disciplined mathematical vocabulary from dynamical systems and elementary mechanics, while keeping symbolic and empirical claims separate.
epistemic_rule: The equations below are established mathematics or physics. Their use for Dog, Farm, Door, Axis, Ladder or spiritual language is analogical/modeling work unless independently operationalized and tested. They do not prove Potatoverse theology or a new physical force.

limit_cycle.mathematics: A limit cycle is an isolated closed trajectory of an autonomous dynamical system and corresponds to periodic non-constant behavior.
limit_cycle.return_map: A Poincare return map samples a trajectory each time it returns to a chosen transverse section; fixed points of the map correspond to periodic orbits.
limit_cycle.project_use: This is a much more precise comparator for recurrence than the word circle alone. A recurring controversy or behavioral loop can be represented as repeated returns to a region of state space, but evidence is needed before claiming a true dynamical limit cycle.

linear_spiral_flow.key_result: A logarithmic spiral arises naturally when radial change is exponential in time while angular motion is uniform. The logarithmic-spiral parameter is b=alpha/beta.

regimes.alpha_zero: constant radius: circular/center-like recurrence in this toy model
regimes.alpha_negative: radius contracts exponentially: inward spiral / sink-like behavior
regimes.alpha_positive: radius expands exponentially: outward spiral / source-like behavior

linear_spiral_flow.potato_axis_bridge: For the recovered Potato Axis r=a exp(b theta), b=2 ln(phi)/pi≈0.30635 can be interpreted mathematically as the ratio alpha/beta in this simple flow. This supplies a dynamical interpretation template, not a physical identification of alpha or beta.
linear_spiral_flow.source_neighbor: Standard planar linear systems with complex eigenvalues alpha ± i beta exhibit spiral sinks for alpha<0 and spiral sources for alpha>0.

closed_return_vs_transformed_return.closed_return: State returns to the same or equivalent point/region after a period.
closed_return_vs_transformed_return.spiral_return: Angular phase can recur while radial or vertical state changes.
closed_return_vs_transformed_return.holonomy_neighbor: In geometry, transport around a closed path can return to the same location while an internal vector/state is transformed. The repository already tracks holonomy as a rigorous neighbor for 'return changed'.
closed_return_vs_transformed_return.project_insight: The important question is not merely 'did it come back?' but 'which state variables returned and which changed?' This prevents circular and spiral recurrence from being confused.

separatrix_and_door.mathematics: Separatrices are invariant trajectories/curves associated with qualitative boundaries between dynamical regions or sectors; in saddle systems they divide nearby trajectory families.
separatrix_and_door.project_use: Door can be compared to a boundary-crossing or guard surface between basins/regimes. A separatrix is especially useful for distinguishing 'approaching a threshold' from actually entering another dynamical region.
separatrix_and_door.caution: A Door is not literally a separatrix unless a concrete dynamical system, state variables and invariant boundary are defined.

orbit_mechanics.uniform_circle: Even constant-speed circular motion is accelerated motion because velocity direction continuously changes.
orbit_mechanics.direction: Acceleration points toward the center; instantaneous velocity is tangential.
orbit_mechanics.release_insight: If the center-directed constraint/force maintaining a circular path disappears, inertia carries the object along the tangent rather than around the old circle.
orbit_mechanics.project_use: As a systems analogy, persistent orbit around a controversy requires some continuing inward feedback, incentive or coupling. Remove the sustaining coupling and the loop need not persist. This is not a claim that social attention obeys Newtonian gravity.

wheel_helix_ladder.pitch: vertical displacement per full turn = 2 pi u/omega
wheel_helix_ladder.wheel_case: u=0 gives rotation with no axial progress
wheel_helix_ladder.ladder_spiral_case: u != 0 gives recurrent angular motion plus axial displacement
wheel_helix_ladder.project_insight: This gives a clean 3D distinction: Wheel = rotation around Axis; Helix/Ladder-Spiral = rotation plus movement along Axis. The value and sign of u encode whether a turn changes vertical level and in which direction.

potato_axis_exact_bridge.interpretation: A full 360-degree return restores angular direction while not restoring radius. This is an exact mathematical example of recurrence without identical state: same angle-class, different scale.
potato_axis_exact_bridge.project_value: This is stronger than metaphorically saying 'spiral means return at another level'; the existing project equation literally has angular recurrence plus scale displacement.

state_space_taxonomy.fixed_point: no macroscopic change in modeled state
state_space_taxonomy.limit_cycle: isolated periodic orbit attracting/repelling/organizing neighboring trajectories depending on stability
state_space_taxonomy.spiral_sink: rotational recurrence with contraction toward a fixed point
state_space_taxonomy.spiral_source: rotational recurrence with expansion away from a fixed point
state_space_taxonomy.basin: set of starting states converging toward an attractor
state_space_taxonomy.door: project transition relation capable of moving an agent/state between regimes

dog_farm_translation.dog_return: behavioral/symbolic recurrence comparator: return to an already-discarded state
dog_farm_translation.farm_loop: attention/reaction/archive incentives can be modeled as feedback capable of stabilizing recurrence
dog_farm_translation.orbital_dog: project term for pursuit that repeatedly circles an unresolved center
dog_farm_translation.exit: change the feedback law, remove sustaining coupling, cross a threshold, or change state variables enough that the old return map no longer returns to the same basin
dog_farm_translation.ethical_boundary: These models describe patterns and relations; they are not diagnoses or permanent classifications of persons.

new_research_questions: Can recurring project/social patterns be represented by an explicit state vector X and empirically estimated return map rather than metaphor alone?
Which variables distinguish a healthy repeated practice from a pathological loop: information gain, repair, radius/scale change, entropy, dependency, or capability?
Can Door events be operationalized as detected basin transitions or regime changes?
Does the recovered Potato Axis parameter b correspond to any historically intended ratio, or was it chosen solely to enforce golden-ratio quarter-turn scaling?
Can a 3D helix become the canonical mathematical distinction between Wheel and Ladder/Spiral without overwriting the original 2D logarithmic spiral?
